- Collaborating with and mentoring current graduate students

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Investigated sound propagation through seagrass with an acoustic resonance chamber
- Designed and performed both in situ and ex situ laboratory experiments to study acoustic properties of seagrass.
- Measured and compared sound characteristics of coffee bean roasting with various bean types using acoustical and machine learning techniques.

positions.title: General Engineering Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Taught two sections of Engineering Physics II courses
- Prepared four one-hour lectures weekly for classes of 15 students

company.name: University of Wisconsin-Madison Plasma Physics Department

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Modifying an existing soft x-ray tomography emission model to be more easily integrated into a Markov Chain Monte Carlo analysis by decreasing computation time.
- Translated code from IDL to Python

positions.title: Undergraduate Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed a multi-filter experiment to try and measure impurity radiation 
- Converted a numerical soft x-ray model from IDL to Python for 3X performance upgrades
- Helped a post doc with data collection on the Madison Symmetric Torus
- Assisted in the assembly of 4 probes of a soft x-ray tomography diagnostic
- Used AutoCAD to dimension over 60 parts for fabrication

honors.title: First Prize, Best Student Paper Award in Animal Bioacoustics
honors.description: I was awarded first prize by the Animal Bioacoustics Technical Committee for my presentation titled "Ultrasonic Transmission Behavior in Posidonia oceanica Rhizomes."

honors.title: Second Prize, Best Student Paper Award in Acoustical Oceanography
honors.description: I was awarded second prize by the Acoustical Oceanography Technical Committee for my presentation "Variations in ultrasonic transmission behavior along seagrass leaf blades" at the Fall 2017 Meeting of the Acoustical Society of America.
honors.issuer: Issued by Acoustical Society of America · Dec 2017

organizations.description:

- Brought in 11 industry sponsors, 21 Faculty Judges, and more than 60 Student presenters
- $15,000 operating budget for event space, food, and awards
